newsitem.title: GREECE: Hellenic Bottling to buy 30pct stake in Frigoglass.
newsitem.headline: Hellenic Bottling to buy 30pct stake in Frigoglass.

text.p: Greece's Hellenic Bottling said it will buy a 30 percent stake in Frigoglass SA, a manufacturer of commercial refrigeration displays, valued at 8.2 billion drachmas via a share capital increase, it said in a statement.

Frigoglass, which manufactures commercial refrigeration displays under the brand name of Frigorex, one of the leading names worldwide, has production facilities in Greece and Romania, and is currently constructing another one in Indonesia, it said.

Frigoglass will increase its share capital by 14.1 billion drachmas ($57.6 million) to finance its investment programme and Hellenic Bottling will contribute 8.2 billion drachmas ($33.6 million), it said.

The net cash outflow for Hellenic Bottling will be 5.9 billion drachmas ($24 million) and the rest, 2.3 billion drachmas ($9.6 million), will be covered by a transfer of shares from 3P SA, plastics in Bulgaria and Romania, Crown International SA, bottle crowns in Romania, and Greek V.P.I., it said.

Frigoglass' investment programme includes the completion of the cooler manufacturing facility in Indonesia, acquisition of glass production capacity in Bulgaria and Nigeria, plastics production in Armenia, modernisation of cooler, plastics and crowns production facilities in Nigeria and others, it said.
All required valuations have been carried out by Coopers and Lybrand, it said.

Frigoglass also owns a 25 percent stake in Yioula SA, the leading glass industrial firm in Greece. The pre-tax profits of Frigoglass are estimated at 1.1 billion drachmas or $4.5 million and its turnover at 12.2 billion drachmas or $50 million without including income from the participation in Yioula.
The consolidated pre-tax profits of Yioula are projected to reach 1.4 billion drachmas or $5.7 million, it said.
"Through the above restructuring, Hellenic Bottling will be a significant shareholder in a major industrial group with activities related to the food and beverage industry," it said.
